raw_result.summary: T031's missing registry construction/admission seam is corrected within the existing architecture classification and AGENTS.md Worker-tool/shared-authority trigger. The contract now names the mandatory registry constructor, positive admission/disposition deadlines, `AdmitAsync(binding,purpose,token)` result/status, host `ObserveAsync` and `VerifyAndHoldAsync` inputs/results, scoped `CheckCurrentAsync`/`DisposeAsync` hold, and previous-generation settlement verifier. T031 can construct the registry with controlled dependencies and exercise Closed→Open→borrow before T033's binding producer exists; controlled fake proof is distinct from selected-host qualification. Successful admission owns held root/metadata/app-only mutex proof; failed/cancelled admission disposes partial holds, while Closing/Unknown never reopens. Same-process Absent→Creating→Ready preserves immutable approval/root/owner/OwnershipId and reloads monotonic versions; fresh-process Ready remains Closed/Unknown until independently verified old child/handle settlement. Closure of new grants leaves current CodeGraph-purpose authority available for freshly checked disposition. The 48 existing IDs, one typed record/store, 18.1 public read contract and 18.3 native/ordinary-reader ownership remain. CodeGraph-enabled application composition stays closed until 18.3 qualifies ordinary read exclusion, direct reads, budgets/continuations and native readiness. Feasibility, invariants, compatibility, Constitution I/V and AD-3/4/6/15 alignment and the callable-seam lesson were self-reviewed. Prior plan reviews 01–15 and definition reviews 01–14 remain historical; their resolved findings are preserved. The T031 discovery produced no test/production write or RED. Operator admission, approved principal, selected-host ACL/mutex, actual 18.3 settlement, first-PATH JDT/restricted profile and native permissions remain prerequisites, not inferred authority or qualification. Any necessary new owner/schema/root/authority decision returns to root before implementation.
